stage.name: s2_3c_critic
stage.notes: dopamine critic built from cells (dopamine cell with a resting rate, habenula, ventral striatal value cells, fast pallidal and slow striosomal paths: TD) in the harsh world; the reversal at 800 from generation HARSH_CALM on; control the 2.2 brain

reversal_bites.caption: From the same recorded lives.

conditioning_lab.caption: Lab test on 24 creatures of the last generation of every seed: a new look shown at the mouth, three bites with pain (or none), then four ticks of nothing; read out from a rested brain, learning off. The drive is the input of the aversive cells before their ceiling.

dopamine_shift.caption: The critic's error on every tick of a trial, mean of 24 creatures of the last generation of every seed. Negative: worse than expected.
